title: Company's Telemetry – Storage
description: Replace the telemetry stub with persistent storage: create telemetry_events in Supabase (indexes, immutable write-only), per-event TelemetryEvent.model_validate with partial batch acceptance (no typed list body → 422), bulk-insert valid rows in one transaction, preserve CONTEXT-specific tags from telemetry-plan.md, return received/stored/rejected — frontend unchanged, same endpoint URL.

description.en: Replace the telemetry stub with persistent storage: create telemetry_events in Supabase (indexes, immutable write-only), per-event TelemetryEvent.model_validate with partial batch acceptance (no typed list body → 422), bulk-insert valid rows in one transaction, preserve CONTEXT-specific tags from telemetry-plan.md, return received/stored/rejected — frontend unchanged, same endpoint URL.
description.es: Sustituye el stub de telemetría por almacenamiento persistente: crea telemetry_events en Supabase (índices, solo escritura inmutable), TelemetryEvent.model_validate por evento con aceptación parcial del lote (sin body tipado list → 422), inserta filas válidas en bulk en una transacción, preserva tags específicos del CONTEXT según telemetry-plan.md, devuelve received/stored/rejected — frontend sin cambios, misma URL de endpoint.
